title: Ἡ Ὀψία καὶ Ὁ Ὕπνος
subtitle: Unit 1, Chapter 3 — The Evening and Sleep

panels.scene: Teaches: ὀψία, μακρός, νύξ — Evening. The day is long, and the night is near.
panels.greekCaption: ὀψία ἐστίν. ἡ ἡμέρα μακρά ἐστιν. ἡ νὺξ ἐγγύς ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: It is evening. The day is long. The night is near.

captionTranslations.es: Es tarde. El día es largo. La noche está cerca.
captionTranslations.pl: Jest wieczór. Dzień jest długi. Noc jest blisko.
captionTranslations.fil: Gabi na. Matagal ang araw. Malapit na ang gabi.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὤμος, ἐπί — The farmer carries the lamb on his shoulder.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς φέρει τὸ ἀρνίον ἐπὶ τῷ ὤμῳ αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer carries the lamb on his shoulder.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor lleva al cordero en su hombro.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik niesie jagnię na ramieniu.
captionTranslations.fil: Dinadala ng magsasaka ang kordero sa kanyang balikat.

panels.scene: Teaches: κοπιάω, ὅλος — The lamb is weary. It ran the whole day. (εἷς → πολλοί: one lamb amid many labors)
panels.greekCaption: τὸ ἀρνίον κοπιᾷ. ἔτρεχεν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
panels.englishCaption: The lamb is weary. It ran the whole day.

captionTranslations.es: El cordero está cansado. Corrió todo el día.
captionTranslations.pl: Jagnię jest zmęczone. Biegło cały dzień.
captionTranslations.fil: Pagod ang kordero. Tumakbo ito buong araw.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὁδός — The road leads toward the house. The farmer walks on the road.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς βαδίζει ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ πρὸς τὸν οἶκον.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer walks on the road toward the house.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor camina por el camino hacia la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik idzie drogą ku domowi.
captionTranslations.fil: Lumalakad ang magsasaka sa daan patungo sa bahay.

panels.scene: Reinforces: ἀκολουθέω, ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ — The sheep follows the farmer on the road.
panels.greekCaption: τὸ πρόβατον ἀκολουθεῖ τῷ γεωργῷ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The sheep follows the farmer on the road.

captionTranslations.es: La oveja sigue al agricultor en el camino.
captionTranslations.pl: Owca podąża za rolnikiem na drodze.
captionTranslations.fil: Sumusunod ang tupa sa magsasaka sa daan.

panels.scene: Teaches: σελήνη, ἀνατέλλω — The moon rises in the sky. Stars begin to appear.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ σελήνη ἀνατέλλει ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The moon rises in the sky.

captionTranslations.es: La luna sale en el cielo.
captionTranslations.pl: Księżyc wschodzi na niebie.
captionTranslations.fil: Sumisinag ang buwan sa langit.

panels.scene: Reinforces: λάμπω, ἐπί — The moon shines on the field and on the river.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ σελήνη λάμπει ἐπὶ τὸν ἀγρὸν καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμόν.
panels.englishCaption: The moon shines on the field and on the river.

captionTranslations.es: La luna brilla sobre el campo y sobre el río.
captionTranslations.pl: Księżyc świeci nad polem i nad rzeką.
captionTranslations.fil: Sumisinag ang buwan sa bukid at sa ilog.

panels.scene: Reinforces: βλέπω, χαίρω — The farmer sees the moon and rejoices.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς βλέπει τὴν σελήνην καὶ χαίρει.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sees the moon and rejoices.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor ve la luna y se alegra.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik widzi księżyc i cieszy się.
captionTranslations.fil: Nakikita ng magsasaka ang buwan at nagagalak siya.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἥκω, ἔξω — The farmer arrives outside the house and sets the lamb down.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς ἥκει ἔξω τοῦ οἴκου. τίθησιν τὸ ἀρνίον.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer arrives outside the house. He puts down the lamb.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor llega afuera de la casa. Pone al cordero.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik przybywa przed dom. Kładzie jagnię.
captionTranslations.fil: Dumating ang magsasaka sa labas ng bahay. Ibinaba niya ang kordero.

panels.scene: Reinforces: καταλείπω, ἔξω — He leaves his animals outside. They settle beside the house.
panels.greekCaption: καταλείπει τὰ ζῷα ἔξω τοῦ οἴκου.
panels.englishCaption: He leaves the animals outside the house.

captionTranslations.es: Deja a los animales afuera de la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Zostawia zwierzęta przed domem.
captionTranslations.fil: Iniwan niya ang mga hayop sa labas ng bahay.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἀνοίγω, θύρα — He opens the door of the house.
panels.greekCaption: ἀνοίγει τὴν θύραν τοῦ οἴκου.
panels.englishCaption: He opens the door of the house.

captionTranslations.es: Abre la puerta de la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Otwiera drzwi domu.
captionTranslations.fil: Binuksan niya ang pinto ng bahay.

panels.scene: Teaches: μόνος — The farmer is alone in the house.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς μόνος ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer is alone in the house.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor está solo en la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik jest sam w domu.
captionTranslations.fil: Nag-iisa ang magsasaka sa bahay.

panels.scene: Teaches: σκοτία — Darkness in the house. He cannot see. He stretches out his hand.
panels.greekCaption: σκοτία ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ. οὐ βλέπει.
panels.englishCaption: There is darkness in the house. He cannot see.

captionTranslations.es: Hay oscuridad en la casa. No puede ver.
captionTranslations.pl: W domu jest ciemność. Nie może widzieć.
captionTranslations.fil: Madilim sa bahay. Hindi siya makakita.

panels.scene: Teaches: ζητέω — He seeks the lamp. He searches with his hands in the dark.
panels.greekCaption: ζητεῖ τὸν λύχνον. ψηλαφᾷ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ.
panels.englishCaption: He seeks the lamp. He feels his way in the darkness.

captionTranslations.es: Busca la lámpara. Se mueve a tientas en la oscuridad.
captionTranslations.pl: Szuka lampy. Idzie po omacku w ciemności.
captionTranslations.fil: Hinahanap niya ang ilawan. Naghahanap siya sa kadiliman.

panels.scene: Teaches: λύχνος, τράπεζα — He finds the lamp on the table.
panels.greekCaption: εὑρίσκει τὸν λύχνον ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης.
panels.englishCaption: He finds the lamp on the table.

captionTranslations.es: Encuentra la lámpara sobre la mesa.
captionTranslations.pl: Znajduje lampę na stole.
captionTranslations.fil: Nahanap niya ang ilawan sa mesa.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἅπτω — He lights the lamp.
panels.greekCaption: ἅπτει τὸν λύχνον.
panels.englishCaption: He lights the lamp.

captionTranslations.es: Enciende la lámpara.
captionTranslations.pl: Zapala lampę.
captionTranslations.fil: Sinindihan niya ang ilawan.

panels.scene: Teaches: φῶς, οὐκέτι — Light! No longer darkness. The room glows warm.
panels.greekCaption: φῶς ἐστιν νῦν. οὐκέτι σκοτία ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: There is light now. There is no longer darkness.

captionTranslations.es: Hay luz ahora. Ya no hay oscuridad.
captionTranslations.pl: Teraz jest światło. Już nie ma ciemności.
captionTranslations.fil: May liwanag na ngayon. Wala nang kadiliman.

panels.scene: Reinforces: ἄρτος, καρπός, ἐπί — Bread and fruits are on the table. The lamp glows beside them.
panels.greekCaption: ἄρτος καὶ καρπὸς ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης εἰσίν.
panels.englishCaption: Bread and fruit are on the table.

captionTranslations.es: Hay pan y fruta sobre la mesa.
captionTranslations.pl: Na stole jest chleb i owoce.
captionTranslations.fil: May tinapay at bunga sa mesa.

panels.scene: Teaches: καθέδρα — The farmer sits down on the chair beside the table.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς καθίζει ἐπὶ τὴν καθέδραν.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sits down on the chair.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor se sienta en la silla.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik siada na krześle.
captionTranslations.fil: Nakaupo ang magsasaka sa silya.

panels.scene: Teaches: πολύς, χρόνος — Much time digging and carrying. He remembers the long day.
panels.greekCaption: πολὺν χρόνον ἔσκαπτεν καὶ ἔφερεν.
panels.englishCaption: He dug and carried for a long time.

captionTranslations.es: Cavó y cargó por mucho tiempo.
captionTranslations.pl: Kopał i nosił przez długi czas.
captionTranslations.fil: Humukay at nagdala siya nang matagal.

panels.scene: Reinforces: ἐσθίω — He eats the bread and the fruits by lamplight.
panels.greekCaption: ἐσθίει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ τοὺς καρπούς.
panels.englishCaption: He eats the bread and the fruits.

captionTranslations.es: Come el pan y las frutas.
captionTranslations.pl: Je chleb i owoce.
captionTranslations.fil: Kumain siya ng tinapay at mga bunga.

panels.scene: Reinforces: λάμπω, φῶς, σελήνη — The lamp shines inside; the moon shines outside.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύχνος λάμπει ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ· ἡ σελήνη λάμπει ἔξω.
panels.englishCaption: The lamp shines in the house; the moon shines outside.

captionTranslations.es: La lámpara brilla en la casa; la luna brilla afuera.
captionTranslations.pl: Lampa świeci w domu; księżyc świeci na zewnątrz.
captionTranslations.fil: Sumisinag ang ilawan sa bahay; sumisinag ang buwan sa labas.

panels.scene: Teaches: σφόδρα, κοπιάω — He is exceedingly weary. He can hardly keep his eyes open.
panels.greekCaption: σφόδρα κοπιᾷ. οὐκέτι δύναται καθίζειν.
panels.englishCaption: He is exceedingly weary. He can no longer sit.

captionTranslations.es: Está muy cansado. Ya no puede sentarse.
captionTranslations.pl: Jest bardzo zmęczony. Nie może już siedzieć.
captionTranslations.fil: Napakahirap niya. Hindi na siya makapagupó.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἔτι — He is still in the chair, but he rises to go to the bed.
panels.greekCaption: ἔτι κάθηται, ἀλλ᾽ ἐγείρεται πρὸς τὴν κλίνην.
panels.englishCaption: He is still sitting, but he rises toward the bed.

captionTranslations.es: Aún está sentado, pero se levanta hacia la cama.
captionTranslations.pl: Wciąż siedzi, ale wstaje ku łóżku.
captionTranslations.fil: Nakaupo pa rin siya, ngunit bumabangon patungo sa higaan.

panels.scene: Teaches: κλίνη — The bed in the house.
panels.greekCaption: κλίνη ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ.
panels.englishCaption: There is a bed in the house.

captionTranslations.es: Hay una cama en la casa.
captionTranslations.pl: W domu jest łóżko.
captionTranslations.fil: May higaan sa bahay.

panels.scene: Teaches: καθεύδω — The farmer sleeps on the bed. The lamp glows softly.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς καθεύδει ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sleeps on the bed.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor duerme en la cama.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik śpi na łóżku.
captionTranslations.fil: Natutulog ang magsasaka sa higaan.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὕπνος — The farmer sleeps. The lamp still shines; the moon is outside.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς καθεύδει. ὁ ὕπνος αὐτοῦ εἰρηνικός ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer sleeps. His sleep is peaceful.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor duerme. Su sueño es tranquilo.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik śpi. Jego sen jest spokojny.
captionTranslations.fil: Natutulog ang magsasaka. Mapayapa ang kanyang tulog.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὕπνος (dream) — Sleep. He enters a dream. The field is hazy and strange.
panels.greekCaption: ἐν τῷ ὕπνῳ βλέπει τὸν ἀγρόν.
panels.englishCaption: In his sleep he sees the field.

captionTranslations.es: En su sueño ve el campo.
captionTranslations.pl: W śnie widzi pole.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa kanyang panaginip nakikita niya ang bukid.

panels.scene: Teaches: εἷς, πολύς — One stone, then many stones. The field is full of great stones.
panels.greekCaption: εἷς λίθος — πολλοὶ λίθοι. ὁ ἀγρὸς πλήρης λίθων ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: One stone — many stones. The field is full of stones.

captionTranslations.es: Una piedra — muchas piedras. El campo está lleno de piedras.
captionTranslations.pl: Jeden kamień — wiele kamieni. Pole jest pełne kamieni.
captionTranslations.fil: Isang bato — maraming bato. Puno ng bato ang bukid.

panels.scene: Teaches: πρῶτος — The farmer lifts the first stone.
panels.greekCaption: αἴρει τὸν πρῶτον λίθον.
panels.englishCaption: He lifts the first stone.

captionTranslations.es: Levanta la primera piedra.
captionTranslations.pl: Podnosi pierwszy kamień.
captionTranslations.fil: Itinaas niya ang unang bato.

panels.scene: Teaches: δεύτερος — He lifts the second stone. Many more remain.
panels.greekCaption: αἴρει τὸν δεύτερον λίθον. πολλοὶ δὲ ἔτι μένουσιν.
panels.englishCaption: He lifts the second stone. But many still remain.

captionTranslations.es: Levanta la segunda piedra. Pero aún quedan muchas.
captionTranslations.pl: Podnosi drugi kamień. Ale wciąż wiele pozostaje.
captionTranslations.fil: Itinaas niya ang pangalawang bato. Ngunit marami pa ring natitira.

panels.scene: Reinforces: πολύς — Many stones still remain. He can barely make a dent.
panels.greekCaption: πολλοὶ λίθοι ἔτι μένουσιν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ.
panels.englishCaption: Many stones still remain in the field.

captionTranslations.es: Aún quedan muchas piedras en el campo.
captionTranslations.pl: W polu wciąż pozostaje wiele kamieni.
captionTranslations.fil: Marami pa ring bato sa bukid.

panels.scene: Teaches: δυνατός, πᾶς — It is not possible to lift all the stones.
panels.greekCaption: οὐ δυνατόν ἐστιν αἴρειν πάντας τοὺς λίθους.
panels.englishCaption: It is not possible to lift all the stones.

captionTranslations.es: No le es posible levantar todas las piedras.
captionTranslations.pl: Nie jest mu możliwe podniesienie wszystkich kamieni.
captionTranslations.fil: Hindi niya kayang iangat ang lahat ng bato.

panels.scene: Teaches: στενάζω — He grows weary and groans among the stones.
panels.greekCaption: κοπιᾷ σφόδρα καὶ στενάζει.
panels.englishCaption: He is exceedingly weary and groans.

captionTranslations.es: Está muy cansado y gime.
captionTranslations.pl: Jest bardzo zmęczony i jęknie.
captionTranslations.fil: Napakahirap niya at humihinga nang malalim.

panels.scene: Teaches: ποῦ — Where is the lamb? Where is the sheep? He looks around frantically.
panels.greekCaption: ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ ἀρνίον; ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ πρόβατον;
panels.englishCaption: Where is the lamb? Where is the sheep?

captionTranslations.es: ¿Dónde está el cordero? ¿Dónde está la oveja?
captionTranslations.pl: Gdzie jest jagnię? Gdzie jest owca?
captionTranslations.fil: Nasaan ang kordero? Nasaan ang tupa?

panels.scene: Reinforces: φεύγω, ἀπό — The sheep flee from the farmer into the distance.
panels.greekCaption: τὰ πρόβατα φεύγουσιν ἀπὸ τοῦ γεωργοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: The sheep flee from the farmer.

captionTranslations.es: Las ovejas huyen del agricultor.
captionTranslations.pl: Owce uciekają od rolnika.
captionTranslations.fil: Tumakas ang mga tupa mula sa magsasaka.

panels.scene: Reinforces: λύκος (plural), πέραν, ἰδού — Behold! Many wolves across the river.
panels.greekCaption: ἰδού! πολλοὶ λύκοι εἰσὶν πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: Behold! Many wolves are across the river.

captionTranslations.es: ¡Mira! Hay muchos lobos al otro lado del río.
captionTranslations.pl: Patrz! Wiele wilków jest po drugiej stronie rzeki.
captionTranslations.fil: Tingnan! Maraming lobo sa kabilang dako ng ilog.

panels.scene: Teaches: διαβαίνω — The wolves are about to cross over the river.
panels.greekCaption: οἱ λύκοι μέλλουσιν διαβαίνειν τὸν ποταμόν.
panels.englishCaption: The wolves are about to cross over the river.

captionTranslations.es: Los lobos están a punto de cruzar el río.
captionTranslations.pl: Wilki zaraz przeprawią się przez rzekę.
captionTranslations.fil: Malapit nang tumawid ang mga lobo ng ilog.

panels.scene: Reinforces: ταχέως, φωνή — He cannot run quickly; his voice is small. A nightmare.
panels.greekCaption: οὐ δύναται τρέχειν ταχέως. ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ μικρά ἐστιν.
panels.englishCaption: He cannot run quickly. His voice is small.

captionTranslations.es: No puede correr rápidamente. Su voz es pequeña.
captionTranslations.pl: Nie może szybko biec. Jego głos jest mały.
captionTranslations.fil: Hindi siya makapagmadaling tumakbo. Maliit ang kanyang boses.

panels.scene: Teaches: φόβος — Great fear takes him. His eyes are wide, his face pale.
panels.greekCaption: φόβος μέγας λαμβάνει αὐτόν.
panels.englishCaption: Great fear takes him.

captionTranslations.es: Un gran miedo lo toma.
captionTranslations.pl: Ogarnia go wielki strach.
captionTranslations.fil: Puno siya ng malaking takot.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἐξαίφνης — Suddenly outside the house — many doors! A surreal dream shift.
panels.greekCaption: ἐξαίφνης ἔξω τοῦ οἴκου ἐστίν. πολλαὶ θύραι εἰσίν.
panels.englishCaption: Suddenly he is outside the house. There are many doors.

captionTranslations.es: De repente está afuera de la casa. Hay muchas puertas.
captionTranslations.pl: Nagle jest przed domem. Jest wiele drzwi.
captionTranslations.fil: Biglaan nasa labas na siya ng bahay. Maraming pinto.

panels.scene: Teaches: θαυμάζω — He wonders at the doors. Which one is his?
panels.greekCaption: θαυμάζει τὰς θύρας. ποία ἐστὶν ἡ θύρα αὐτοῦ;
panels.englishCaption: He wonders at the doors. Which is his door?

captionTranslations.es: Se maravilla ante las puertas. ¿Cuál es su puerta?
captionTranslations.pl: Dziwi się przy drzwiach. Które są jego drzwi?
captionTranslations.fil: Namumangha siya sa mga pinto. Alin ang kanyang pinto?

panels.scene: Reinforces: πρῶτος, σκοτία, ἀνοίγω — He opens the first door — darkness.
panels.greekCaption: ἀνοίγει τὴν πρώτην θύραν — σκοτία.
panels.englishCaption: He opens the first door — darkness.

captionTranslations.es: Abre la primera puerta — oscuridad.
captionTranslations.pl: Otwiera pierwsze drzwi — ciemność.
captionTranslations.fil: Binuksan niya ang unang pinto — kadiliman.

panels.scene: Teaches: πανταχοῦ — He opens the second door — darkness everywhere.
panels.greekCaption: ἀνοίγει τὴν δευτέραν θύραν — σκοτία πανταχοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: He opens the second door — darkness everywhere.

captionTranslations.es: Abre la segunda puerta — oscuridad en todas partes.
captionTranslations.pl: Otwiera drugie drzwi — wszędzie ciemność.
captionTranslations.fil: Binuksan niya ang pangalawang pinto — kadiliman sa lahat ng dako.

panels.scene: Teaches: τρίτος — Finally he opens the third door and walks in.
panels.greekCaption: τέλος ἀνοίγει τὴν τρίτην θύραν καὶ εἰσέρχεται.
panels.englishCaption: Finally he opens the third door and enters.

captionTranslations.es: Finalmente abre la tercera puerta y entra.
captionTranslations.pl: W końcu otwiera trzecie drzwi i wchodzi.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa wakas binuksan niya ang ikatlong pinto at pumasok.

panels.scene: Teaches: ἔσω — Inside the house, he seeks the lamp. All is dark.
panels.greekCaption: ἔσω τοῦ οἴκου ζητεῖ τὸν λύχνον. σκοτία ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: Inside the house he seeks the lamp. It is dark.

captionTranslations.es: Dentro de la casa busca la lámpara. Está oscuro.
captionTranslations.pl: W domu szuka lampy. Jest ciemno.
captionTranslations.fil: Sa loob ng bahay hinahanap niya ang ilawan. Madilim.

panels.scene: Teaches: πίπτω — He falls because he cannot see the way.
panels.greekCaption: πίπτει ὅτι οὐ βλέπει τὴν ὁδόν.
panels.englishCaption: He falls because he cannot see the way.

captionTranslations.es: Se cae porque no puede ver el camino.
captionTranslations.pl: Upada, bo nie może widzieć drogi.
captionTranslations.fil: Nahulog siya dahil hindi niya makita ang daan.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὡς — The animals sit on the chairs like (ὡς) men. A surreal dream vision.
panels.greekCaption: τὰ ζῷα κάθηνται ἐπὶ τῶν καθεδρῶν ὡς ἄνθρωποι.
panels.englishCaption: The animals sit on the chairs like men.

captionTranslations.es: Los animales se sientan en las sillas como personas.
captionTranslations.pl: Zwierzęta siedzą na krzesłach jak ludzie.
captionTranslations.fil: Nakaupo ang mga hayop sa mga silya tulad ng mga tao.

panels.scene: Reinforces: θαυμάζω — The farmer wonders greatly and stares at the animals.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς θαυμάζει σφόδρα καὶ βλέπει τὰ ζῷα.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer wonders greatly and looks at the animals.

captionTranslations.es: El agricultor se maravilla mucho y mira a los animales.
captionTranslations.pl: Rolnik bardzo się dziwi i patrzy na zwierzęta.
captionTranslations.fil: Lubos na namumangha ang magsasaka at tinitingnan ang mga hayop.

panels.scene: Reinforces: λέγω, φωνή — The donkey speaks: 'We want to eat the fruits and the bread.'
panels.greekCaption: ὁ ὄνος λέγει· θέλομεν ἐσθίειν τοὺς καρποὺς καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους.
panels.englishCaption: The donkey says: 'We want to eat the fruits and the bread.'

captionTranslations.es: El asno dice: 'Queremos comer las frutas y el pan.'
captionTranslations.pl: Osioł mówi: «Chcemy jeść owoce i chleb.»
captionTranslations.fil: Sinabi ng asno: 'Gusto naming kumain ng mga bunga at tinapay.'

panels.scene: Teaches: τίς — 'What are you saying? For you are an animal!'
panels.greekCaption: τί λέγεις; ζῷον γὰρ εἶ!
panels.englishCaption: 'What are you saying? For you are an animal!'

captionTranslations.es: '¿Qué estás diciendo? ¡Pues eres un animal!'
captionTranslations.pl: «Co mówisz? Jesteś bowiem zwierzęciem!»
captionTranslations.fil: 'Ano ang sinasabi mo? Hayop ka kasi!'

panels.scene: Reinforces: ἀνοίγω, οὐ δυνατόν — He cannot open the door. He pushes but it will not move.
panels.greekCaption: οὐ δύναται ἀνοίγειν τὴν θύραν.
panels.englishCaption: He cannot open the door.

captionTranslations.es: No puede abrir la puerta.
captionTranslations.pl: Nie może otworzyć drzwi.
captionTranslations.fil: Hindi niya mabuksan ang pinto.

panels.scene: Reinforces: κράζω, φωνή μεγάλη — He cries out: 'I do not want this!'
panels.greekCaption: κράζει μεγάλῃ φωνῇ· οὐ θέλω!
panels.englishCaption: He cries out with a great voice: 'I do not want this!'

captionTranslations.es: Grita con gran voz: '¡No quiero esto!'
captionTranslations.pl: Krzyczy wielkim głosem: «Nie chcę tego!»
captionTranslations.fil: Sumigaw siya nang malakas: 'Ayaw ko nito!'

panels.scene: Teaches: ἐγείρω — His own voice wakes him. He sits up suddenly in bed.
panels.greekCaption: ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ἐγείρει αὐτόν. ἐξαίφνης ἀνίσταται.
panels.englishCaption: His voice wakes him. He suddenly sits up.

captionTranslations.es: Su voz lo despierta. De repente se sienta.
captionTranslations.pl: Jego głos go budzi. Nagle siada.
captionTranslations.fil: Ginising siya ng kanyang boses. Biglaan nakaupo siya.

panels.scene: Teaches: ὀφθαλμός — He opens his eyes and looks around at his house.
panels.greekCaption: ἀνοίγει τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ βλέπει τὸν οἶκον.
panels.englishCaption: He opens his eyes and looks at his house.

captionTranslations.es: Abre sus ojos y mira su casa.
captionTranslations.pl: Otwiera oczy i patrzy na swój dom.
captionTranslations.fil: Binuksan niya ang kanyang mga mata at tinitingnan ang kanyang bahay.

panels.scene: Reinforces: ζητέω, ἔξω, ἰδού — He looks outside. Behold — his animals rest peacefully.
panels.greekCaption: ζητεῖ τὰ ζῷα. ἰδού — ἔξω ἡσυχάζουσιν.
panels.englishCaption: He seeks his animals. Behold — they rest peacefully outside.

captionTranslations.es: Busca a sus animales. ¡Mira — descansan tranquilamente afuera!
captionTranslations.pl: Szuka swoich zwierząt. Patrz — odpoczywają spokojnie na zewnątrz!
captionTranslations.fil: Hinahanap niya ang kanyang mga hayop. Tingnan — nagpapahinga silang mapayapa sa labas!
